title: chore(secrets): remove write-only dataclass fields in registry
claim: registry AppliedVar.name/shape/overrode_env and SourceReport.skipped_claimed/_protected/_invalid are write-only and can be removed.

evidence.source: The claim still holds structurally on main: production reads only AppliedVar.source/.authoritative and SourceReport.applied/.skipped_existing/.result/.label/.name (hermes_cli/env_loader.py:128-129, :226, :695, :714, :716-728, :735-742). No string/getattr/asdict access exists. But these are populated provenance-record fields, not unreachable code. AppliedVar is documented as the 'Provenance record' and the apply_all docstring documents skipped_claimed. tests/secret_sources/test_secret_source_registry.py:163-164 asserts .shape and .overrode_env as part of test_applies_secrets_and_records_provenance.
evidence.references_before: registry.py:51-54 and :64-71 (fields), :358/:361/:364 (appends), :376 (positional AppliedVar(var, source.name, source.shape, overrode_env=..., authoritative=...)); tests: test_secret_source_registry.py:163-164, plus AppliedVar/SourceReport constructors in 4 test files.

upstream_overlap: #115984 (kshitijk4poor, MERGED 2026-09-19) added AppliedVar.authoritative and reshaped registry into an applier class: the fork diff is stale and needs a full rebuild.
No open PR targets these fields.
notes: HOLD, not READY. Removing provenance/diagnostic fields asserted by a behaviour test is a design call that shrinks the record, not mechanical dead-code deletion. It touches the security-sensitive secret-source path that was reworked recently (#74265/#115984), and the bot diff no longer applies. Low value and nonzero review cost. Revisit only if a maintainer wants the provenance record slimmed. Not plugin-facing: SecretSource plugins implement fetch() and never see ApplyReport.
